snippets.name: Find product code by name and uninstall an MSI
snippets.code:
$products = Get-ADTApplication -Name '<application name>'
$productcode = $products.ProductCode

#Uninstalling MSI
Start-ADTMsiProcess -Action 'Uninstall' -ProductCode "$productcode"

snippets.name: Find product by name and uninstall an EXE
Uninstall several MSI product codes in a loop
snippets.code:
##Uninstall several MSI product codes in a loop
$products = Get-ADTApplication -Name '<application name>'

foreach($product1 in $products)
{
   $productcode = $product1.ProductCode

   #Uninstalling MSI
   Start-ADTMsiProcess -Action 'Uninstall' -ProductCode "$productcode"
}

snippets.name: Apply HKCU settings to all users (Invoke-ADTAllUsersRegistryAction)
Active Setup - install
snippets.code:
#Setting HKCU:\Software\Autodesk\Inventor registry
Copy-ADTFile -Path "$($adtSession.dirSupportFiles)\Activesetup_Install.ps1" -Destination "Install_dir\ActiveSetup"
Copy-ADTFile -Path "$($adtSession.dirSupportFiles)\Activesetup_Install.reg" -Destination "Install_dir\ActiveSetup"
Set-ADTActiveSetup -StubExePath "$envSystem32Directory\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe" -Arguments "-ExecutionPolicy Bypass -NoProfile -File `"Install_dir\ActiveSetup\Activesetup_Install.ps1`"" -Description "users settings registries" -Key $VWG_appFullName

snippets.name: Active Setup - uninstall
snippets.code:
#Removing ActiveSetup
Set-ADTActiveSetup -Key "$VWG_appFullName" -PurgeActiveSetupKey

#Removing HKCU Registries
[scriptblock]$HKCURegistrySettings =
{
    Remove-ADTRegistryKey -LiteralPath "HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Active Setup\Installed Components\Application_ActiveSetup_name" -SID $_.SID
}
Invoke-ADTAllUsersRegistryAction -ScriptBlock $HKCURegistrySettings
